svg.title: CL65.4 what the old looks left: one rewritten picture is proved

g.text: CL65.4 what the old looks left: one rewritten picture is proved
the one change: a class's name, a rule,
takes the change out again, and holds
the pictures that differ in more, by

text.tspan: A picture that changes is not looked over:
the one change is taken out again, and the
rest must be the same to the byte.
